name: Lumio Arc 5 Projector (MediaTek)
warnings: Hardware & Projector Safeguards: DO NOT DISABLE projector hardware packages, ToF autofocus, STR8 auto-keystone correction, obstacle avoidance, screen fit, or optical/picture settings.

USB Storage & Media Playback: Keep all USB storage, OTG, and media indexing packages enabled (com.android.externalstorage, com.android.documentsui, com.android.providers.media, com.android.providers.downloads, and MediaTek/OEM USB or file managers) so external flash drives function for video playback.
